notes.title: Update Ver.1.2.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
This is Onidora from StudioActOne.

Thank you for playing Code Reactors.
Today, we have released Update Ver.1.2.3.

Ver.1.2.3

Adjustment Overview
This update includes adjustments aimed at improving the randomness of stage layouts and the usability of magic.
By reducing magic reload times and related tweaks, players can now enjoy smoother and more responsive spellcasting.
Enemy HP values have also been adjusted accordingly for better balance.

Key Changes
・Adjusted the behavior of natural spell reload
・Slightly increased natural MP regeneration speed
・Added new stage patterns to enhance exploration variety
・Made enemy placements along the path more randomized
・Increased HP for some late-game bosses

We will continue to improve the game based on your feedback.
If you have any concerns or suggestions, please share them on the Steam Community.

Thank you for your continued support of Code Reactors!

notes.title: Update Ver.1.2.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43441373/bc64de3298f7c17303f2f4c69a1facb461d27184.jpg
Hello everyone!
This is Onidora from StudioActOne.

Thank you for playing Code Reactors.
Today, we have released Update Ver.1.2.0.

Ver.1.2.0
Adjustments
・Adjusted the behavior of some bosses' minion summoning
・Zoomed the camera out slightly when engaging with enemies
・Adjusted parry effects and performance
　└ Enemies that are parried will now take guaranteed critical hits
　└ Projectiles will be reflected when parried
・Mana Forest: initial exploration now ends at 10F
・Adjusted stick input threshold for left/right movement
・Enemy patterns in forced battles are now selected more randomly
・Improved UI to make it clearer when the first spell in your deck is usable
・Adjusted the following spells: lowered base damage but increased damage scaling with spell boosts
　└ Mana Comet
　└ Prominence Assault
　└ Lightning Assault
　└ Ice Crusher
・Increased base damage for the following spell
　└ Whirlwind Blade

Content Additions
・New spells added
　└ Strike Arrow
　└ Snowball
　└ Snow Drift
　└ Boomerang
　└ Triple Boomerang
　└ Caltrops

New Features
・Added a feature to display the deepest floor reached on the dungeon start screen

Bug Fixes
・Fixed an issue where lasers could be parried
・Fixed a bug where enemies would remain frozen after recovering from Freeze status
　└ (Enemies frozen → Resonance time stop → enemies fail to resume movement)
We will continue to improve the game based on your feedback.
If you have any concerns or suggestions, please share them on the Steam Community.

Thank you for your continued support of Code Reactors!

notes.title: Demo Version 2.0.0 Released!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43441373/0afcc1c599901e7fca2e5a7c570baffb3647c069.jpg
Hello everyone!
This is Onidora from StudioActOne.

We’re excited to announce that the demo version 2.0.0 of Code Reactors is now available!

In this new demo, you can experience the opening part of the main story.
With our unique "Card × Roguelite × Action" system, you'll enjoy a variety of card-based actions and thrilling battles.

If you’re a fan of roguelites or action games, or even just a little curious, we hope you’ll give it a try!

We’ll continue working to make Code Reactors even better based on your feedback, so we’d love to hear your thoughts and impressions.

Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy Code Reactors!

notes.title: Update Ver. 1.0.2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43441373/0b879f548bed9200ed96dddf68fb7a13415b45bf.jpg
Hello everyone,
This is Onidora from StudioActOne.

Thank you for playing Code Reactors.
Today, we have released Ver.1.0.2, which includes bug fixes and game balance adjustments.

Ver.1.0.2

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the effect of the relic "Broach of Dawn" did not activate upon reload completion.
 Fixed an issue where the power boost effect of the spell "Triple Missile" was not working correctly.
 Fixed an issue where the attack sound effect of the boss "Iron Arbitrator" would continue to play after a game over during the battle.
 Implemented a temporary fix for an issue where the event might not progress after defeating the boss "Iron Arbitrator."
   This issue is still under investigation and may occur again.
   If you encounter this problem, please share your experience on the Steam Community.


Adjustments

 Adjusted some enemy projectiles so they no longer pass through walls.
 Adjusted boss AI to prevent certain behavior loops under specific conditions.
 Adjusted actions so that players can reload while moving outside of combat.


We will continue to improve the game based on your feedback.
If you have any concerns or suggestions, please share them on the Steam Community.

Thank you for your continued support of Code Reactors.

notes.title: Update Ver. 1.0.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43441373/691859751b8ed3a74ba885101d01945d62bcd083.jpg
Hello everyone!
This is Onidora from StudioActOne.

Thank you for playing Code Reactors!
Today, we have released Ver. 1.0.1. This update includes bug fixes and game balance adjustments.

Ver. 1.0.1 

Bug Fixes

 UI: Fixed an issue where chain numbers would be cut off when exceeding three digits.
 Opening Guide Adjustment: Clarified the "Recall" action guide by specifying that it requires a long press.
 Fixed an issue with stage generation in the first lighthouse.
 Fixed a bug where players could not return to the home base from the menu in areas with a Return Mana Stone.
 Fixed an issue on Steam Deck where the language could not be changed from the title screen.


Adjustments

 Reduced the cost required for upgrades.
 Adjusted the selling price of certain relics.
 Beginner Difficulty: Lowered enemy HP.
 Standard Difficulty: Reduced player damage taken.
 Reduced player stagger time after taking damage (improving resistance to consecutive attacks).


We will continue to provide updates and strive to make the game even better!
Thank you for your support!
